exposure: singleton or multiples in a single pregnancy
elevated weight and length at birth
cohort: Newborns and infants under 3 years of age with available specific immunoglobulin E (sIgE) data
finding: Early-life egg white and wheat sensitization was associated with increased birth body length and weight, and higher total IgE levels were associated with egg white sensitization.
mod_finding: Spontaneous delivery vs. cesarean section was examined as a perinatal characteristic but no findings related to mode of delivery were reported.
